### Identify the 18 genes included in the published T-cell–inflamed GEP and examine their expression in the dataset

18 genes included in the dataset

```{r}

GEP_genes <- c('CCL5', 'CD27', 'CD274', 'CD276', 'CD8A', 'CMKLR1', 'CXCL9', 'CXCR6', 'HLA-DQA1', 'HLA-DRB1', 'HLA-E', 'IDO1', 'LAG3', 'NKG7', 'PDCD1LG2','PSMB10', 'STAT1', 'TIGIT')
```

```{r}
res_tcell <- res[rownames(res) %in% GEP_genes, ]

res_tcell
```

```{r}
res_tcell <- as.data.frame(res_tcell)
```

Genes with an adjusted p-value less than 0.05

```{r}
res_tcell_sig <- res_tcell[
  !is.na(res_tcell$padj) & res_tcell$padj < 0.05,
]

res_tcell_sig
```

Genes with p-value \< 0.05 and log2Foldchange \> 0.5

```{r}
res_tcell_interesting <- res_tcell[
  !is.na(res_tcell$pvalue) &
  res_tcell$pvalue < 0.05 &
  abs(res_tcell$log2FoldChange) > 0.5,
]

res_tcell_interesting

```

### Calculate a T-cell–inflamed GEP score for each patient.

```{r}
# 2. Get transformed expression values from DESeq2
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
expr <- assay(vsd)

```

```{r}
# 3. Find which genes are present
GEP_genes_present <- GEP_genes[GEP_genes %in% rownames(expr)]

setdiff(GEP_genes, GEP_genes_present)

```

```{r}
# 4. Extract the genes
GEP_expr <- expr[GEP_genes_present, , drop = FALSE]
GEP_expr
```

```{r}
# 5. Standardize expression for each gene
GEP_expr_scaled <- t(scale(t(GEP_expr)))
GEP_expr_scaled
```

```{r}
# 6. Calculate average expression score per patient
GEP_scores <- colMeans(GEP_expr_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)
GEP_scores
```

```{r}
GEP_df <- data.frame(
  Patient = colnames(expr),
  BOR = colData(dds)$BOR,
  GEP_score = GEP_scores
)
```

```{r}
GEP_df
```

```{r}
boxplot(
  GEP_score ~ BOR,
  data = GEP_df,
  xlab = "Best Overall Response",
  ylab = "T-cell-inflamed GEP score"
)
```
